study.title: Try Human Rounds
study.invitation: Help us improve Human Rounds: after this screen you'll get tasks with instructions to do in the demo. It takes about 8 minutes. Use example data, never your own or a patient’s data.

study.not_stored: We do not save your name, identity number, IP address, passwords, form values or images. We do not record your screen.
